2488602.adulto: Pale grayish-blue head and body, slightly paler and grayer below; wings and tail brighter cerulean blue with darker edges to the flight feathers; shoulder (lesser wing coverts) bright violet-blue with no white wing patch (Andean and Caribbean race); short stout dark gray bill; dark eye; dark gray legs.

9436876.adulto: Dull olive-gray overall with a faint violet-blue gloss on back and underparts; forecrown and face washed yellowish-olive; two-toned wing: pale yellowish-olive coverts and bases of the flight feathers contrasting sharply with a blackish outer half of the wing; blackish tail; stout gray bill; dark eye.

2491862.adulto: Bright canary-yellow overall; distinct orange forecrown; back olive-yellow with faint dusky streaks; wings and tail dusky with yellow-olive feather edges; short conical pale horn-colored bill; pinkish legs.
2491862.juvenil: Grayish-brown above with dusky streaks; whitish below finely streaked brown; a distinct yellow band across the breast and yellow undertail coverts; no orange on the crown; conical pale bill.
